'''2005 World Championship Day 2 Drew Scott LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Drew Scott]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2005-09-27).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35176 Worlds Day 2 - Drew Scott's MWYHL]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225057/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35176 Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Drew Scott]]
